idea-plugin.name: metatron docs build
idea-plugin.description:
Right-click a docs source file to build it and open the result, with fast single-file turnaround.
  • docs/skills/**/*.md -> MarkdownRunner (single-file, --html) -> processed markdown opened in the editor and the rendered sibling .html opened in the browser.
  • docs/website/adoc/*.adoc -> AsciiDocRunner (the adoc tree is one book; --single-boot) -> opens docs/website/tractatus.html in the browser.
Shells out to the metatron uber-jar (same runners as bin/metatron-build-docker docs). Build output streams to target/docs-build.log.

Like bin/metatron, it rebuilds the uber-jar automatically (./mvnw install -DskipTests) whenever sources changed since the last build, then runs the doc compiler.

action.description: Build the selected .md / .adoc and open the result
